mission._velocity_fields: Derived offline from the position series; the runner's own per-sample differencing of consecutive TF lookups returned identical transforms between TF updates and collapsed to zero. Per-sample track.v_par / track.speed are RAW finite differences at the ~0.1 s sim track spacing and are quantisation-noisy (they can exceed the 0.784 m/s velocity cap). The mission-level aggregates here, and every velocity quoted in README.md, use a 0.5 s sim uniform resample of the same series, which is the figure to cite.
